pg: SELECT hc.cust_first_name , hc.cust_last_name , hc.cust_email , w.masked_column6 , ho.order_total , TO_CHAR( ho.order_date , 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS COL_ALIAS , RPAD( hc.masked_column1 , 8 ) AS RPADCOL , TO_CHAR( ho.customer_id , 'FM99G999G999G999D000' ) AS COL_ALIAS_0 , 0.0 , 0.0 FROM h_customers hc INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id CROSS JOIN warehouses w INNER JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id WHERE ho.order_total > 5000 AND l.country_id = 'US' AND hc.cust_first_name NOTNULL AND EXTRACT( MONTH FROM DATE( '03/10/1986' ) ) = EXTRACT( MONTH FROM ho.order_date ) AND w.masked_column6 ILIKE '%SOUTHLAKE, TEXAS%' AND XPATH_EXISTS( '/Warehouse/Parking' , w.warehouse_spec ) AND l.state_province ILIKE '%TEXAS%' AND l.state_province ILIKE '%TEXAS%' UNION ALL SELECT NULL , NULL , NULL , NULL , REGR_SLOPE( h.masked_column4 , c.account_mgr_id ) AS COL_ALIAS , NULL , NULL , NULL , h.customer_id , SUM( h.order_total ) AS total_order_amount FROM h_orders h INNER JOIN h_customers c ON h.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN warehouses w ON w.masked_column6 = 'New Jersey' GROUP BY h.customer_id HAVING SUM( h.order_total ) > 1000

  SELECT 
    term_code,
    fall_instructors,
    subject_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY term_code) AS total_subjects,

  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE term_code = '2023FA'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  at.term_description,
  ccso.subject_title,
  ccso.prerequisites,
  sc.total_subjects,
  ccso.fall_instructors,
  sc.experience,
  ADD_MONTHS(at.last_day_of_classes, 3) AS ADDDATE_INTERVALCOL,
  TO_CHAR(at.last_day_of_classes, 'Mon DD, YYYY') AS COL_ALIAS,

WHERE ccso.term_code = '2023FA'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(ccso.warehouse_load_date AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL '732496' MICROSECOND) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM at.add_date) < 2
UNION ALL

  w.masked_column6 AS nearest_warehouse,

  NULL,
  0.0,
  NULL,
  0.0,
  DATE '2025-05-30',
  NULL,
  0.0,
  NULL
FROM h_customers hc
INNER JOIN h_orders ho ON hc.customer_id = ho.customer_id
CROSS JOIN warehouses w
LEFT JOIN locations l ON w.location_id = l.location_id
